meta.title: Prescription Policy — Getmeds
meta.description: Rules and requirements for uploading and verifying medical prescriptions on Getmeds Philippines.

heading: Prescription Policy
requirements: Valid prescription from a licensed physician registered in the Philippines (PRC ID required).
Must clearly state patient full name, date, medication name, dosage, quantity, and doctor signature/license details.
Special Dangerous Drugs (S2) require an official PDEA yellow prescription form.
Prescriptions must not be expired or exceed maximum allowable refills.
